title: Whitewashed bricks
description: Add new whitewashed bricks for decoration with ANY color!
body:
# **Use new blocks to decorate your buildings - whitewashed bricks!**
This datapack adds 2 new blocks for decoration:
- **Whitewashed bricks**. Just white bricks
- **Slightly whitewashed bricks**. Whitewashing does not occupy the block completely.

![Whitewashed bricks!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6af7ad8ce30b0a075ed382c6c782e480ecc6dd45.png)

- Whitewash is crafted on a crafting table with calcite, bone meal, potion, clay and paper. 64 uses of one item!

![Whitewash craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/21076043e6418e5d6368dd749f578761ea8d7230.gif)

## **Dyeing mechanics!**
Craft a pounder to mix dyes and use it to dye whitewash on bricks! Dyeing works like the vanilla dyeing mechanic of leather armor, so the whitewash can be dyed in ANY HEX color possible

![Pounder with dye!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0dd414c7df3bd68e36465d81bd9d89577ce42382.png)

## **Interact with tools!**
- **Axes.** Use an axe to scrape the whitewash off the brick while keeping the color!

  ![Scrath whitewash!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/72de7c924d73188f07e226148a6dc2be8b70b8cd.gif)
- **Shovel**. With it you can change the variation for slightly whitewashed bricks. Up to 3 different variations!

  ![Change whitewash variation!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ece27af58630d6f8f5cb74eaa9afd8706bcb331e.gif)

### Feel free to leave your feedback! You also can give an idea in the comments to which blocks to add whitewash
### =D
